section_summary: This section covers U.S. State Department records from 1932 to 1939 regarding the acquisition and transfer of merchant vessels by Japanese interests. It documents reports on Japanese purchases of European, Canadian, and American ships for scrapping or operation, as well as an unsuccessful effort to transfer Japanese-owned Chinese-flag vessels to Panamanian registry. The major focus is the late 1938 contract by Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha to purchase ten cargo steamers from Lykes Brothers Steamship Company, which was thwarted when the U.S. Maritime Commission and State Department refused to approve the transfer of flag and credit arrangements.

subfiles.about: Details the terms and conditions for the sale of ten cargo steamers by Lykes Bros. Steamship Company to Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha.
subfiles.from: Lykes Bros. Steamship Company, Inc. and Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha
subfiles.summary: Agreement under which Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha agrees to purchase ten cargo steamers from Lykes Bros. Steamship Company for $125,000 each. The purchase is payable through cash and installment notes secured by ship mortgages and a guarantee from the Yokohama Specie Bank, contingent on Maritime Commission approval for transfer to Japanese registry. The document incorporates notarial acknowledgments, Yamashita Kisen's power of attorney to Kumazo Imaye, a sample promissory note, and an installment payment schedule.
subfiles.title: Agreement between Lykes Bros. Steamship Company, Inc. and Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha for Sale of Ten Steamers
subfiles.to: Lykes Bros. Steamship Company, Inc. and Yamashita Kisen Kabushiki Kaisha

subfiles.from: Joseph C. Green, Chief, Division of Controls
subfiles.summary: Memorandum recording conferences where State Department officials discouraged credit transactions for vessel purchases and noted Maritime Commission disapproval.
subfiles.title: Memorandum of Conversations with Mr. James W. Ryan regarding Proposed Sale of Ten American Vessels to Japanese Interests

subfiles.title: Maritime Commission Policy and Performance Bonds on Vessel Sales to Japanese Ownership
